name: Brevo Free
free_limit: Brevo Free: 300 emails sent/day and storage for up to 100,000 contacts, with no plan expiry
watch_out: Unused daily sends do not roll over. Campaigns above 300 recipients require manually requeuing remaining contacts; transactional messages can queue up to 1,000 excess sends. Free includes Brevo branding, 1 account user, basic reporting and up to 2,000 unique contacts entering automations. Paid plan required for higher quotas and advanced features.
